newsitem.title: UK: Specialeyes denies talk of rival bidder.
newsitem.headline: Specialeyes denies talk of rival bidder.

text.p: British retail optician Specialeyes Plc on Tuesday denied that a counter bidder to Optical Express had reared its head, offering eight pence a share for control of the Middlesex-based optician.

The counter-bidder, tipped by the Daily Mail newspaper as Spectacle Express, had said it was not contemplating bidding against Optical Express. Specialeyes insisted it was not in talks with a third party.
Specialeyes earlier recommended a six-pence-per-share offer from Optical Express as being in the best interest of employees and shareholders.
If the bid fails, the optician has warned that it would need to launch a major restructuring which would be "likely to impact adversely upon shareholder value".
